dct_description_sm: Only clip of Reserves No. 2, 4, 6 were georeferenced. Inset map of Similkameen 12 Reserve was not georeferenced.

Georeferenced map of Lower Similkameen Band reserves Similkameen 2, Narcisse's Farm 4 and Blind Creek 6 south east of Keremeos clipped from original map Plan No. 2 of Similkameen Indian Reserves, Osoyoos Division, Yale District (https://doi.org/10.58066/bxg7-sw89) which states Reserves No. 2, 3 and 5 were amalgamated and are known as Reserve No. 2. Land cover and features described on the map includes huts, fields, and the types of soil, land, and timber.
